cuda_event_ground_truth: torch.cuda.Event elapsed time around isolated matmul loops

interpretation.reason: The isolated matmul kernels completed between 50 ms nvidia-smi samples; utilization overlap was zero or near zero despite nonzero CUDA-event durations. This is a sampling-resolution limitation, not evidence of zero GPU work.
interpretation.scientific_boundary: This measurement records CUDA-event ground truth for isolated matmul workloads and contemporaneous aggregate utilization samples. It does not establish per-request vLLM GPU seconds and must not be used as an E2E simulator calibration row.
